name: win-wallpaper-manager
title: Wallpaper Manager
description: Manages wallpapers from both Wallhaven and Local Folders.
author: hermes

commands.name: wallpaper-manager
commands.title: Wallpaper Manager
commands.description: Manage your Wallhaven and Local wallpapers.

commands.name: auto-switch
commands.title: Auto Switch
commands.description: Randomly selects a wallpaper based on your settings.

preferences.name: localFolderPath
preferences.title: Local Wallpapers Folder
preferences.description: Folder where local wallpaper images are stored and read from.

preferences.name: downloadFolderPath
preferences.title: Download Folder
preferences.description: Folder where Wallhaven wallpapers will be saved (Leaves empty for default Downloads folder).

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
